summary: Micro:bit simulator button A/B functionality with variable tracking tested and fixed. Found and fixed a bug where variables were being reset on each button click instead of persisting.
passed_tests: MicrobitSimulator renders correctly with all buttons (A, B, Reset, Play, Flash)
Button A click triggers 'Button A pressed!' in console output
Button B click triggers 'Button B pressed!' in console output
Variable tracking: code with 'count = 0' and 'count = count + 1' works correctly
display.show(variable) resolves variable to number and shows LED pattern
Multiple button A clicks increment the count (persistent state) - FIXED
Reset button clears variables and LED state
Run button with non-button code (e.g. display.show(Image.HEART)) works correctly
set_pixel with variable arguments resolves correctly (x=2, y=2, brightness=9)
Button B decrement (count = count - 1) works correctly
The simulator doesn't crash or show errors
critical_code_review_comments: Fixed bug in parseCode(): When a button is pressed, initialization code (count = 0) was being re-executed, resetting the variable. Added filter to skip non-loop, non-button-block code when buttonAState or buttonBState is true.
Fixed bug in executeCommands(): When keepState is true (button press), loop iterations were running 5 times instead of 1. Changed to only run 1 iteration for button presses.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Micro:bit simulator button functionality is now working correctly. The fixes made: (1) In parseCode() at line ~617, added filter to skip initialization code when a button is pressed. (2) In executeCommands() at line ~743, changed loop iterations to 1 when keepState is true (button press). To test: Login as teacher -> Library -> Add to Library -> Select Micro:bit -> Enter button code -> Click Run -> Click Button A/B multiple times -> Verify count increments/decrements correctly.

fix_1.description: Added filter to skip non-loop, non-button-block code when a button state is active

fix_2.description: Changed loop iterations to 1 when keepState is true (button press)
